high_level_description: This image is the cover of Vogue Korea, featuring a model with striking blue-green hair. The model's face is partially obscured by her hands, which are adorned with multiple gold and silver rings. Her wrists are also decorated with several gold and silver bangles. The model has a neutral expression, with her lips slightly parted. The background is a plain, light color, which helps to highlight the model and the jewelry she is wearing. The text on the cover includes "VOGUE KOREA" prominently displayed at the top, followed by the name "Jeannie" in a stylized font.
